name: @speajus/rlsify
description: TypeScript monorepo for simplifying PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies
author: Justin Spears <speajus@gmail.com>

scripts.build: pnpm run buf:generate && pnpm -r --filter='./packages/*' run build
scripts.clean: pnpm -r run clean && rm -rf node_modules packages/types/src/gen
scripts.docker:setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env')){fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env');console.log('✅ Created .env file from .env.example\n📝 Edit .env to customize your configuration')}else{console.log('⚠️  .env file already exists')}"
scripts.docker:up:
docker-compose up -d && echo '
✅ RLSify is running!
🌐 UI: http://localhost:5174
🗄️  PostgreSQL: localhost:5432

Run npm run docker:logs to view logs
Run npm run docker:db:shell to access the database'
scripts.docker:up:tools:
docker-compose --profile tools up -d && echo '
✅ RLSify is running with tools!
🌐 UI: http://localhost:5174
🗄️  PostgreSQL: localhost:5432
🔧 pgAdmin: http://localhost:5050'
scripts.docker:clean: docker-compose down && echo '✅ Containers removed (data preserved)'
scripts.docker:reset: docker-compose down -v && echo '✅ Containers and volumes removed (fresh start)\nRun npm run docker:up to start fresh'
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker-compose build ui && docker-compose up -d ui && echo '✅ UI container rebuilt and restarted'
scripts.docker:db:shell: docker-compose exec postgres psql -U rlsify -d rlsify
scripts.docker:db:test: docker-compose exec -T postgres psql -U rlsify -d rlsify -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/test-rls-policies.sql
